title: Sobekneferu
summary: Last ruler of Egypt's Dynasty 12; CFAH identifies her with the barren royal daughter who raised Moses.
description: Last ruler of Egypt's Dynasty 12; CFAH identifies her with the barren royal daughter who raised Moses. Person record added by the CFAH pass for CFAH's reign dates; dates are as printed in the CFAH paper cited.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the death entry (no later than 1525 BC). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.

death.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 6: The Old and Middle Kingdoms of Egypt," ARJ 18 (2025): 13–60, section "12. Barren Queen with Moses"
death.note: "Sobekneferu died no later than 1525 BC, and probably about a year earlier." CFAH adds that if she was at least 25 when Moses was born her birth was no later than 1596 BC (conjecture; not recorded as a birth date).

reign.date: Start Sole-rex: 1530; Death or Deposition: April, 1526
reign.citation: Griffith & White, "CFAH-7A: A Chronological Baseline for Dynasty 12," OSF preprint of 11 Jun 2025 (no version number), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/GMX5J, file CFAH-7A Chronological Baseline for Dynasty 12.pdf, Table 3 "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 12", p. 55
